title: Add shared records-history cutover fixture for core and cli tests
summary: Build a reusable test helper that creates a scratch repo with a bare remote and real-writer history: bootstrap, one old-way landed job with trailers, then the cutover job with landing record, import commit and legacy-exempt record on athena/records. Add a shape-asserting test, document reuse for the trailer job and job 7 part 2, and add a CHANGELOG entry. Audience: maintainers and verifiers of later history jobs.

defaults_applied.how: Shape test plus cargo test/clippy/fmt clean.
Criteria run the check commands on the fixture rather than checking existence.
Doc comments and CHANGELOG written for outside readers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The helper may live in athena-core behind a test-support feature or cfg(test) plus a shared path, with athena-cli tests/common/mod.rs reusing it; the exact sharing mechanism is the producer's choice.
History is built only via existing real writers (land, records import, legacy-exempt writer); if they are not callable, the producer reports rather than hand-building commits.
I did not read the writers' code; deliverable paths are estimates.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test using the helper runs `athena check --history` and `athena check --attribution` on the fixture's main and both report no violations; run `cargo test` and see it pass.
A test asserts the old-way landing commit carries its Athena trailers, produced through the real landing path (not hand-built commit text), and that the job was read, dispatched, verified and landed.
A test asserts C0 resolves from the cutover job's landing record on athena/records, and that the import commit and legacy-exempt record exist there; the import manifest self-check passes.
The fixture has a bare remote, a bootstrap commit, and [history] cutover_job names the cutover job; `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` pass.
The helper has doc comments (and a CHANGELOG.md entry) explaining its shape and how the trailer job and job 7 part 2 should reuse it from both athena-core and athena-cli tests.
No production behavior changes: no edits to run.rs, gh.rs, land.rs, or gate code; the fixture is test-only and compiled only for tests.

out_of_scope: Changing production landing, retry_landing, or gate behavior
Implementing the trailer job or job 7 part 2
departures: Three prior attempts failed on fixture realism and this needs real writers across crates, so cost, time, and pass probability are worse than the reference.
